resources.string: Monitors the Samsung Settings screen so Hotspot Scheduler can turn the Mobile Hotspot on and off on your behalf. It reads and clicks the hotspot switch in Settings and nothing else.

Tap to open the Mobile Hotspot settings screen. The app will toggle the switch once it appears.
Required. Lets the app see and press the hotspot switch inside the Samsung Settings app. One UI path: Settings â†’ Accessibility â†’ Installed apps â†’ Hotspot Scheduler â†’ turn On.
Required for data caps. Lets the app read how much tethering data was used today. One UI path: Settings â†’ Apps â†’ â‹® (More) â†’ Special access â†’ Usage access â†’ Hotspot Scheduler â†’ Allow.
Shows the persistent status and alerts. Required on Android 13. Tap Allow in the system dialog.
Required so routine start/end times fire exactly, even in Doze. One UI path: Settings â†’ Apps â†’ Hotspot Scheduler â†’ Alarms and reminders â†’ Allow.

Prevents One UI from killing the automation. 1) Tap below to ignore battery optimizations. 2) Settings â†’ Battery and device care â†’ Battery â†’ Background usage limits â†’ Never sleeping apps â†’ add Hotspot Scheduler. Also check Deep sleeping apps and make sure Hotspot Scheduler is NOT listed there.

Strongly recommended. Lets the app open the hotspot Settings screen by itself in the background. Without it you will get a notification to tap each time a toggle is needed. One UI path: Settings â†’ Apps â†’ Hotspot Scheduler â†’ Appear on top â†’ Allow.

One UI path: Settings â†’ Battery and device care â†’ Battery â†’ Background usage limits â†’ Put unused apps to sleep â†’ make sure the toggle is Off, or add Hotspot Scheduler to Never sleeping apps. This is the most common reason automation silently stops after a day or two.

Phone has a PIN or fingerprint lock? Android forbids any app from unlocking it. Tip: Settings â†’ Lock screen â†’ Extend Unlock â†’ Trusted places â†’ add your home. The phone stays unlocked at home (automation works hands-free) but keeps your PIN everywhere else.
One-time step. Opens the Mobile Hotspot settings screen and captures every control on it so you can confirm which switch is the hotspot toggle. Do this once per One UI update.

Password must be at least 8 characters, or leave empty to keep the Settings password.
The app drives the Settings screen directly. It wakes the phone, turns the hotspot or mobile data on or off, then puts the screen back to sleep. No companion app and no root.

A PIN, pattern or password IS set. Android does not allow any app to type a lock-screen password, so the app cannot unlock by itself: it will wake the screen and wait for you. For hands-free operation remove the lock credential, or trust your location (Settings - Lock screen - Extend Unlock - Trusted places).
No PIN, pattern or password set. The app can wake the screen and dismiss the lock screen on its own - fully hands-free.
Only a swipe lock is set. The app can dismiss this automatically.

Grants one permission only: force-lock, used to put the screen back to sleep after a scheduled change. This is the only way an app can turn the screen off. No passwords, cameras or factory reset are affected.
Device administrator is on - the app can turn the screen off
Not enabled - the screen will stay on after a change
Allows Hotspot Scheduler to lock the screen after a scheduled hotspot or mobile data change. This is the only permission it requests.
Put the screen back to sleep after a change
Unlock needed to change the hotspot

The phone was locked with a PIN or password. Android does not let apps type a lock-screen password, so the change was not applied. Remove the lock credential, or add this location to Trusted places, for hands-free operation.
